title: Depth at a vertex
statement: For a circuit with $n$ input vertices and a natural-number vertex index $v$, the depth at $v$ is the entry of the circuit's depth list at index $v$, or zero if that index is out of range.
caveat: The formal statement refers to a gate-depth operation whose defining meaning is not included in the supplied definitions.
